### v1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated `scripts/floor_monitor.py` with changes (details not specified).
- No updates to documentation or external features.

NFT floor price monitoring and customizable Discord alerts.

- Monitor NFT collection floor prices in real time from sources like Blur and OpenSea.
- Set floor price alerts with Discord DM notifications when targets are reached (above or below threshold).
- Compare up to 5 NFT collections simultaneously.
- Track floor price history and receive alerts on major 24h price changes (>10%).
- Supports JSON output for easy integration with automation workflows.
